summary: Completed comprehensive testing of loan management system with focus on weekly loan functionality. Identified critical backend validation issue preventing weekly loan creation.

critical_bugs.issue: Weekly loan creation fails with 422 error - backend requires taxa_juros_mensal and prazo_meses even for semanal periodicidade
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks all weekly loan creation functionality
critical_bugs.details: EmprestimoCreate model requires taxa_juros_mensal and prazo_meses as non-optional fields, but these should be optional when periodicidade='semanal'

critical_bugs.issue: Weekly loan simulation also fails with 422 error for same validation issue
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot simulate weekly loans before creation

validation_issues.issue: Backend validation does not properly handle conditional required fields based on periodicidade
validation_issues.solution: Make taxa_juros_mensal and prazo_meses Optional when periodicidade='semanal'

authentication_issues.issue: Session not maintained after login - redirects back to login page
authentication_issues.impact: Cannot access application features after login

form_issues.issue: Form always sends taxa_juros_mensal and prazo_meses regardless of periodicidade selection
form_issues.impact: Frontend sends incorrect payload structure for weekly loans
form_issues.details: Lines 34-35 in NovoEmprestimoModal.js always include monthly fields

passed_tests: Monthly loan creation (when including required fields)
Weekly loan creation (when monthly fields are included)

critical_fixes: Update EmprestimoCreate model to make taxa_juros_mensal and prazo_meses Optional when periodicidade='semanal'
Add conditional validation logic in backend to handle weekly vs monthly loan requirements
Fix frontend session management - login redirects back to login page
Update frontend form submission logic to only send relevant fields based on periodicidade selection
action_item_for_main_agent.validation_fix: The backend validation needs to be updated to handle conditional required fields. When periodicidade='semanal', only taxa_juros_semanal and prazo_semanas should be required.
action_item_for_main_agent.frontend_fix: Frontend form should conditionally send fields based on periodicidade selection and session management needs to be fixed.
